overviewHtml:
Site reliability teams need a single view of a service's health, release quality and error budget, plus an alert when the budget burns too fast.

What you get

  • Dashboard with the four golden signals
  • Release validation results from Site Reliability Guardian
  • Availability and performance SLOs
  • Fast burn rate alert and a workflow that sends an email
prereqsHtml:
To ensure that the Dynatrace configurations work as intended:

  • Monaco version v2.24.0+
  • Platform token (See our documentation) covering the needed permissions: Documents, Automation, SLO v2, Settings, email, and additionally app-engine:apps:run
setupHtml:
1. Clone or Download this repository.
  2. In service_monitoring_sample\config.yaml, configure an email address by replacing "myteam@mycompany.com" with your email address, set proper names, tags and event filter parameters as indicated by "#INPUT" comments in the file.
  3. Set your environment variables: You need a Dynatrace Platform environment and the following environment variables to try this out:
  • DT_ENV_URL: https://YOUR-DT-ENVIRONMENT-ID.apps.dynatrace.com
  • PLATFORM_TOKEN: Returned when creating the platform token (see:docs)
  • SERVICE_ID: Add the Dynatrace service entity ID that shall be used in the sample, in the format: "SERVICE-XYXYXYXYXYXYXYXY"
  1. Deploy Dynatrace configurations: Deploy the Dynatrace configurations to your target environment. If you're new to Monaco, see Monaco deploy command for further help.
  2. Set up your CI/CD tool: Set up your CI/CD tool to send deployment events for triggering the release validation official documentation.
  3. Customize as Needed: Adjust the dashboards or detection rules to fit your organization’s release and monitoring processes.
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco, a Dynatrace Platform environment and a platform token.

  1. Set your email address, names and filters in the config
  2. Set the environment variables, including your service ID
  3. Deploy with Monaco and send deployment events from your CI/CD tool

Full setup instructions are in the README.
